answer: The archive holds the proof long after the epoch ends, so a lie has nowhere to grow old. Take the hollow away and the name goes; take the velvet away and the stake goes; take the delta away and the past goes. Renewal charges 169 POA every epoch, so the farm's 579 masks bleed 97851 POA again next epoch. No story crosses this threshold, only each drilled bead is a measured gem yield plus a guild signature, which is what Bead stringer drilled bead seal faceted in the cutting bench requires.
